faqs.question: What is the Easy UV used for?
faqs.answer: An economic UV/Vis spectrophotometer for fast, routine wavelength, concentration, color, and water quality testing.

faqs.question: What is ScanStart™?
faqs.answer: A function that, paired with a handheld barcode scanner, reads the 2D barcode on Spectroquant® water test kits and automatically loads the correct testing method.

faqs.question: What is the wavelength and photometric accuracy?
faqs.answer: Wavelength accuracy of ±1.5 nm, and photometric accuracy of ±0.005 A measured against K2Cr2O7 reference.

faqs.question: Is it pharmacopeia compliant?
faqs.answer: No, the Easy UV is not pharmacopeia compliant.

faqs.question: How many methods can it store?
faqs.answer: Up to 80 methods, with 10 shortcuts available per user.

faqs.question: What path lengths does it support?
What is the light source?
faqs.answer: A Xenon flash lamp, with scanning optics.

faqs.question: What are the dimensions and weight?
faqs.answer: 176 × 201 × 362 mm (H×W×D), weighing 4.25 kg including the terminal.

faqs.question: What languages does it support?
faqs.answer: Bahasa Indonesia, Chinese, English, French, German, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, and Thai.

faqs.question: Can it connect to a computer?
faqs.answer: Yes, via USB interface, with EasyDirect UV/VIS PC software available for data acquisition, storage, and display.

faqs.question: What is the price of the Easy UV in India?
faqs.answer: Get in touch and Inkarp will put together a quote based on the ScanStart™ configuration and accessories required.

faqs.question: Who is the authorized distributor of the Easy UV in India?

longForm.heroHook: Scan a barcode, run the method. ScanStart™ makes water testing genuinely simple.
longForm.heroLead: Easy UV is Mettler Toledo's economic entry point into UV/Vis spectrophotometry, covering the full 190 to 1,000 nm range with scanning optics and a Xenon flash lamp light source. Wavelength accuracy holds to ±1.5 nm, and photometric accuracy reaches ±0.005 A against K2Cr2O7 reference. The ScanStart™ function, paired with the handheld barcode scanner, reads the 2D barcode directly off Spectroquant® water test kits, loading the correct method automatically rather than requiring manual selection. Up to 80 methods store on the instrument, with 10 shortcuts available per user for the routines run most often. Path length options span 1 inch and 10 mm through 50 mm, and the whole workflow runs from a 4.3" capacitive touchscreen.

sections.title: ScanStart™ Explained
sections.description: Learn what barcode-driven method loading actually removes from routine water testing on the Mettler Toledo Easy UV.
body: Running a Spectroquant® water test kit normally means finding the right method in a menu, matching it to the specific kit and parameter being tested, and setting it up correctly before the actual measurement can happen. That's a manual step that scales badly across a lab running many different water parameters through the day.

ScanStart™, paired with the handheld barcode scanner, removes it. Scan the 2D barcode printed on the test kit, and Easy UV loads the correct method automatically, no menu search, no manual matching. The SQKitReader™ option extends this further, reading the barcode with an internal reader built into the instrument itself.
